English:
Intelligence has narrowed the SCUD's location down to an area in the Kolgujevian mountains. You will lead a combined Special Forces and regular infantry squad to first locate and then destroy the missile. Support will be on hand from the Zulu tank force and November's Cobra gunships.

- You are advised to remain undetected until you have located the missile and are ready to attack it.
- Any premature engagement could cause Guba to bring forward the missile launch.
- There will be many enemies. Tanks, Shilkas, infantry, SpezNatz...
- Be careful. Do not sacrifice tanks and choppers... unless it's absolutely necessary to complete your mission.
- Good luck.

Intelligence report

July 9, 1985 - Guba's forces are on their knees, but he still has his trump card to play: that nuclear missile.

According to the intelligence report, any full-scale assault would give the Russians enough warning to launch the SCUD prematurely - so I'm going to take in a few key units, get in as close as I can without being spotted, then strike fast and hard.

I've got one hour. It all comes down to this.

And I don't even want to think about what's going to happen if I don't make it...
Search And Destroy
Proceed to the launch area and pinpoint the SCUD as quickly as possible.
The launch site will be heavily defended. Having assessed the situation, call in Zulu (three M1A1s), for help. Advise them whether to proceed by the Eastern or the Western route.
If it's safe to do so, you may also call November (two Cobras) for additional support.
Destroy the SCUD.
Get back in one piece.

Commander, we have approximately one hour before Guba launches his missile. You know what you have to do.

You'll start out with your team close to the SCUD's known position.
